jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
At Hexa Consulting we want to spread transparency and enable diverse tech careers. Based in Portugal, we can answer the increasing demand in the IT sector.

Our mission is to build strong relationships, be a leading partner through a differentiated approach in IT consulting and contribute to the professional and personal development of our team.

We work with Nearshore projects, TM & Project Development, Service Management and Tech Academies.

Responsibilities:
• Perform functional, compatibility, and performance testing on applications for STB platforms.
• Create and execute detailed test cases to ensure the quality and usability of products.
• Identify, document, and report bugs and quality issues clearly and concisely.

Requirements:
• Fluency in both Spanish and English, both oral and written.
• Minimum of 2 years of proven experience as a QA in software development.
• Practical experience with Set-Top Box (STB) tools and testing in related environments.
• Strong analytical and... problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team.

What do we offer?
• Permanent contract
• Health insurance
• Career development
• Access to Training

If you’re living in Portugal or in the EU, and are looking for the right opportunity, don’t waste your time. Be part of this amazing journey!

It’s never just business, we always make it personal

jobs_results.title: QA Test Lead (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
We’re in search of an experienced QA Test Lead (f/m/d) who can play a pivotal role in creating, what we believe, will be the first MMO of its kind.

So who would you be working with?

You would sit in our QA Team team, responsible for helping bring SEED to life through testing.

In this role, you will play a pivotal part in our development process, collaborating closely with our talented developers and Product Owners to ensure a seamless and captivating gaming experience for our users.

Your responsibilities will encompass crafting test plans for the features you work on. As a crucial team member, you will actively participate in Sprint Demos and other essential Scrum rituals. In collaboration with the QA Director, you will work towards achieving quarterly OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), contribute to the refinement of processes, and establish benchmarks for excellence in testing practices.

Supporting fellow QA Test Leads, distributing workloads, sharing insights to enhance our... practices, and assisting in the onboarding of new team members will also be part of your responsibilities.

Part of the QA team works from our Klang HQ in Berlin, and another part of the team works from Madrid, Spain.

So, what would you be doing?
• Overseeing all QA testing efforts and facilitating daily testing needs to ensure comprehensive testing of our game to identify and report bugs and other issues.
• Continually monitoring and updating the bug reporting database to maintain an accurate and up to date reflection of project health.
• * Creating and overseeing the execution of test plans and the creation of detailed test cases to ensure the game meets quality standards.
• Collaborating with developers to escalate and prioritize QA bugs and player feedback/issues, monitoring and pushing critical issues through to resolution.
• Mentoring QA staff and actively and continually developing QA processes, methodologies, and best practices.

You could be the person we are searching for if you have…
• Minimum 3 years of experience working as a QA Test Lead (or similar) in the gaming industry
• Proficiency with Agile Development methodologies.
• Strong knowledge of test management and bug-tracking software.
• The ability to communicate fluently in English, inside and outside of your own domain.
• The ability to work well in a cross-location team, collaborate effectively, and adapt to evolving project requirements.

Bonus points for…
• Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of MMOs and multiplayer experiences.
• Experience with Jira, Confluence
• Previous work on multiplayer networked games, ideally persistent ones.

Our benefits…

Klang Spain
• An opportunity to work on a groundbreaking project with a lot of room for professional and personal development
• Reimbursement for physical health activities
• Employee Assistance Program, including mental health support, legal advice as well as support finding doctor’s appointments
• Mental health support
• Flexible office hours (with core hours)
• Virtual Stock Options (VSOP)
• Competitive salary and 23 days of paid vacation
• Reduced working hours during the month of August
• Private healthcare
• Paid trips to Berlin to attend team events and meet the team

Additional information that may be interesting to you

How we get to know you…
• The recruiter screen: You will have a 45-minute interview with one of the Klang Talent Acquisition Team. During this conversation, you will be asked questions about your motivations for joining us here at Klang and to give an overview of your relevant skills/experience. We will also ask you a set of questions that are linked to our company values.
• Hiring Manager: If successful, you will have a 45-minute interview with Craig Harrison, our QA Director. This is usually the person who you would report to and you will dive much deeper into your experience.
• Culture Add: A 45-minute interview with María Rey (Studio Operations Director) and/or Cathy Liu (Development Director). This is to assess how you would fit into the team as well as for you to decide if you feel there is a team fit from your side.

So what can you expect to be working on after starting with us?

In your first 30 days:
• Onboarding and Relationship Building: Complete the initial onboarding process, including an introduction to Klang's culture, values, and policies. Begin forming connections with members of the QA team and other team members.
• Tool Proficiency: Familiarize yourself with the basic functionalities of test management and bug-tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Testmo). Establish a means of reviewing, understanding and editing the bug database quickly and effectively, and create processes to understand/set bug quality expectations.
• Game Immersion and Initial Testing: Begin immersing yourself in SEED, the game, to understand its basic mechanics and core loops.
• Process Improvement and OKRs: Start observing the current QA processes within the studio, identifying initial areas for improvement. Collaborate with team members on minor process enhancements based on initial observations. Collaborate with Klang QA staff to begin understanding and analyzing existing test coverage and testing practices, putting in place processes to document necessary changes and begin working on making the essential changes.

In your first 60 days:
• Onboarding and Relationship Building: Deepen your understanding of Klang's culture and how it aligns with the studio's mission and vision. Begin meeting regularly with the QA team and providing performance feedback, expectations and change ideas. Begin attending the relevant Feature Team rituals to understand the expectations and contribute where possible.
• Tool Proficiency: Progress in mastering the selected tools, exploring advanced features and configurations. Collaborate with the QA team to establish efficient workflows within these tools. Demonstrate your ability to stay on top of the bug database, maintaining an accurate and useful reflection of SEED, and ensuring high bug quality.
• Game Immersion and Initial Testing: Deepen your understanding of SEED's gameplay mechanics and world. . Engage in discussions with the development team to prioritize and address reported issues.
• Process Improvement and OKRs: Begin actively participating in discussions aimed at optimizing QA workflows. Propose and implement process enhancements or modifications in collaboration with the QA Director. Lead and collaborate on the completion of essential changes to test coverage, practises and processes identified in the first 30 days.

In your first 90 days:
• Onboarding and Relationship Building: Actively participate in QA team meetings and in the relevant Feature Team rituals, and be accountable for the QA-related outcomes, action items and changes needed during/as a result of those meetings.
• Tool Proficiency: Become proficient in using the selected tools to manage and track testing efforts effectively. In addition to your established processes, provide recommendations for tool improvements or customizations to align with QA needs.
• Game Immersion and Initial Testing: Actively play SEED to experience it from a player's perspective, identifying potential user experience improvements. Lead and collaborate on the completion of the remaining changes to test coverage, practises and processes initially identified in the first 30 days, and reassess to identify any new/additional changes.
• Process Improvement and OKRs: Actively contribute to the development and tracking of quarterly Objectives and Key Results (OKRs). Utilize data collected from testing to make data-informed decisions and strategy adjustments.Understand, collaborate on and use the SEED roadmap to create/update and maintain the QA test plan, and ensure that the current test plan is executed against.

In your first 180 days:
• Onboarding and Relationship Building: Serve as a source of knowledge and guidance for new QA team members who join the studio. Demonstrate mentorship skills to support the onboarding of future hires, enhancing team cohesion.
• Tool Proficiency: Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in the selected tools, providing training and support to new team members. Provide measured results for the success of any tool improvements or changes made for QA, so far.
• Game Immersion and Initial Testing: Become well-versed in SEED's core loops, mechanics, and evolving gameplay features. Collaborate with the development team to contribute ideas for enhancing gameplay and player engagement. Ensure that the QA Test Plan has been adhered to, with measured planned VS actual work completed, lessons learned and action items for future changes.
• Process Improvement and OKRs: Lead process improvement initiatives, driving more substantial changes in QA processes based on data and feedback. Serve as a resource for process-related guidance and best practices within the QA team. Provide measured results on the changes that have been made to test coverage, practices and processes, to show QA’s growth and improvements

jobs_results.title: QA Tester Manual
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Optimissa es una empresa de consultoría especializada en Financial Services, siempre en búsqueda permanente de los mayores entusiastas de la Consultoría. Intentamos reinventarnos constantemente para así poder ofrecer el mejor lugar para que nuestros colaboradores puedan desarrollar su carrera y la mejor alternativa como partner para nuestros clientes. Desarrolla tu carrera y escribe tu propia historia.

Nuestros Proyectos

Se caracterizan por un alto grado de complejidad, realizando labores de arquitectura, análisis y desarrollo. Construimos aplicaciones ad-hoc y producto propio para áreas de inversión de las principales entidades financieras.

En esta ocasión estamos ampliando nuestro equipo junto a unos de nuestros principales clientes en el sector bancario en el que requerimos un/a Consultor QA tester manual con al menos 2 años de experiencia

¿Qué conocimientos o experiencia necesitamos?

Conocimientos técnicos:
• Lenguajes de programación: Java, Shell Unix... Macros VB, PL/SQL
• PowerBI
• Bases de datos: SQL, Oracle
• Infraestructura IT: Linux, WAS, Web Servers
• Metodologías Ciclo vida SW: Agile, Waterfall
• Modelo ITIL (deseable)
• Conocimientos de ciclo de vida de SW en todas sus etapas: definición, construcción*, pruebas, despliegue, implantación

Conocimientos funcionales
• Conocimientos / experiencia en sector financiero y mercado de valores
• Conocimientos en estándares financieros: SWIFT

Funiones:
• Apoyo en proyectos de IT y soporte al ciclo de vida del SW: toma de requerimientos, análisis, soporte a pruebas, despliegues.
• Control de entregas de SW e infraestructura por parte de proveedores
• Soporte en UAT y despliegues de SW
• Seguimiento y control de incidencias
• Pequeños desarrollos en Shell scripts y macros
• Elaboración de informes y reportes de seguimiento
• Apoyo en análisis de datos sobre operativa de Custodia y Liquidación y proyectos asociados
• Análisis de flujo de datos entre la operativa de Custodia y Liquidación y Datamart y Web

¿Te parece interesante? ¡Pues continúa leyendo!

Ofrecemos:
• Incorporación estable
• Excelente ambiente de trabajo
• Plan de carrera profesional
• Salario negociable según experiencia
• Plan de Retribución Flexible: combinación de salario base + beneficios que se adaptan a tus circunstancias (Ticket restaurant, seguro médico, cheque guardería, ticket transporte)
• Jornada flexible
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (4 días presenciales en Madrid - Pozuelo de Alarcón)

Si has seguido leyendo hasta aquí y cumples los requisitos....

Únete a Optimissa,

¡Te esperamos

jobs_results.title: QA Tester Mobile (Manual)
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

ODILO is an ed-tech company born in Spain and the founder and trailblazer of the global Unlimited Learning movement. We partner with the most innovative institutions and support over 170 Million users in 50 countries.

ODILO enables organizations to develop their customized unlimited learning ecosystem. That way, they can offer users unlimited access to the world's largest catalog of educational resources on an intelligent platform where they can create any type of educational experience without restrictions.

Only in ODILO can institutions build cultures of unlimited learning possibilities and build sustainable learning habits.

Our team is truly international (19+ nationalities) with the best talent across the education, media, content, and technology sectors.

As a QA Tester Mobile, you will be responsible for the creation of tests to identify issues with our software before the product launch. Duties include identifying... and analyzing any bugs and errors found during the test phase and documenting them for review afterward.

Other tasks include developing and running new tests, reporting on the results, and collaborating with software engineers to fix any issues found.

We are working on achieving a critical mission: Creating equality in education by making the highest quality digital content seamless, accessible, and affordable to all.

Help everyone reach their full potential by providing personalized and intelligent unlimited learning experiences during their whole life.

What you will do at ODILO
• Use critical thinking and analytical skills to discover problems in software.
• Discover, analyze and document defects and risks in the products.
• Analyze bugs and errors found during tests.
• Document and report the results of tests for the software development team.
• Motivate the development process for efficiency and performance.
• Work with the software engineers and the product managers to enhance and improve programs.
• Drive innovation with updated knowledge of industry trends and advancements.

The ideal candidate will bring:
• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
• 1-2 years of proven testing experience in software development companies.
• Exceptional attention to detail.
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
• Great oral and written communication skills.
• Be a team player and able to work efficiently with minimal supervision.
• Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes.
• Proven work experience with mobile devices and different OS.
• Experience working within an agile development team.
• Have a strong desire to solve problems, results-oriented.
• Positive attitude and ability to solve problems autonomously.

What would make us happy:
• Experience working both in an office and within a distributed team.
• Good English, written and spoken.
• Experience with non-functional testing.
• Expertise with any tool for automation testing like Cypress or Selenium.
• Coding skills in Java or Javascript/Typescript.

Why ODILO?

Working at ODILO is about being part of a permanent learning culture, where everyone has the opportunity to take on challenges and participate in the growth of the company.

But we also offer:
• A unique and challenging job within an international, creative, and ambitious work environment.
• Remote work.
• Flexible Compensation Plans: Food, Transportation, Childcare, Training, Health insurance and much more.
• A salary commensurate with track record and experience
• Real opportunities for internal professional development.

…And more!

Sounds like a mission made for you? Then we need to talk!

jobs_results.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Role: Lead QA Engineer

Company: Pearson

Division: English Language Learning

Location: Madrid, Spain (Remote or Hybrid*)

About Pearson:

Our purpose: At Pearson we ‘add life to a lifetime of learning’ so everyone can realise the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. Pearson was founded in 1844 and has been built on our ability to grow with and adapt to a constantly evolving market. Our 20,000+ employees are dedicated to creating the high-quality, digital-first, accessible and sustainable resources for lifelong learning.

About English Language Learning:

In the English Language Learning (ELL) business unit, we aspire to become the world's leading destination to learn and improve English language skills. Our focus is on committed learners from around the world, who are motivated by outcomes because they want to reach their full potential through learning English.

Role overview:

The English Language... Learning (ELL) division of Pearson is looking for a talented and motivated professional to join our growing organization as a QA Lead Engineer.

As a QA Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the robustness and reliability of our products, working closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders. You will lead our QAs, hands-on, to a quality driven mindset where we always put our customers, first, and proactively break our product to ensure that our customers get the best possible, bug free, experience.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead testing efforts across backend, frontend, mobile, and REST APIs.
• Plan and lead software testing, setting priorities in collaboration with the POs – our teams are spread across the globe
• Establish, lead, maintain and continuously improve a suite of robust testing processes throughout development, pre-production, and post-release phases.
• Continuously enhance our automated testing suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of critical system components.
• Promote high degree of QA automation as part of a CI/CD pipelines.
• Define, document and enforce best practice SDLC processes and standards.
• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and customer success managers to deeply understand customer business and use cases.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and troubleshoot defects and bugs, and working to resolve these issues in a timely manner
• Be responsible for testing tools, including but not limited to Mocha, Java + Selenide, Selenium, React Testing Library, Playright, Cypress, and Postman.
• Developing and executing test plans and test cases
• Verify the functionality and performance of software products and applications
• Developing and maintaining automated test scripts
• Participating in code reviews and providing feedback on code quality and testability
• Creating and maintaining automated test suites to increase efficiency and effectiveness
• Participating in release management processes

Qualifications & Skills:
• 6+ years of Agile ways of working, and software development cycle.
• 6+ years of experience in automation suites and manual testing
• ISTQB certification - Test Manager level – is a plus
• Proactive, curious, and driven mindset with a passion for breaking and improving software.
• Ability to deeply understand customer business needs and use cases to ensure software quality.
• Must have strong Leadership skills to support QA team members, and identify/resolve QA challenges through mentoring and guidance,
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional remote teams.
• Detail-oriented, analytical, and possess strong technical skills to ensure that the software meets the required quality standards
• Proficient in at least one programming language, preferably Java
• Experience with Agile and team collaboration tools such as JIRA
• Critical thinking skills to recommend original and productive ideas
• Ability to work effectively with agility and resilience in a fast-paced environment
• Ability to analyse data and information to identify patterns and trends that may indicate problems with the software
• Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and manage their time efficiently to meet project deadlines
• Willing to learn innovative technologies and tools to stay up to date with the latest developments in software testing
• Passion for education and learning

Pearson’s Benefits:
• 24 Days annual leave (increasing by 1 day with every 2 years of continuous service up to 30 days)
• Life insurance Policy
• Work-Life Balance Benefits
• Family Benefits
• Complementary Benefits
• Development and Training Benefits
• Access to Pearson+: Pearson´s digital library
• Discounts on books
• Development and training: a wide access to internal learning platforms and development plan

Diversity: At Pearson we value the power of an inclusive culture and a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture wheredifferences are embraced as strengths and opportunities are equal and accessible.

Flexible working: Pearson is committed to hybrid working practices and has adopted flexible remote and virtual working. Where possible our employees can choose to manage their attendance to the office more flexibly.

How to apply: Thank you for your interest in applying for a role at Pearson. Please submit an updated CV and cover letter (optional) in English. If you have any additional questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

What to expect from Pearson

Did you know Pearson is one of the 10 most innovative education companies of 2022?

At Pearson, we add life to a lifetime of learning so everyone can realize the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. We are on a journey to be 100 percent digital to meet the changing needs of the global population by developing a new strategy with ambitious targets. To deliver on our strategic vision, we have five business divisions that are the foundation for the long-term growth of the company: Assessment & Qualifications, Virtual Learning, English Language Learning, Workforce Skills and Higher Education. Alongside these, we have our corporate divisions: Digital & Technology, Finance, Global Corporate Marketing & Communications, Human Resources, Legal, Strategy and Direct to Consumer. Learn more at We are Pearson.

We value the power of an inclusive culture and also a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture where differences are embraced, opportunities are accessible, consideration and respect are the norm and all individuals are supported in reaching their full potential. Through our talent, we believe that diversity, equity and inclusion make us a more innovative and vibrant place to work. People are at the center, and we are committed to building a workplace where talent can learn, grow and thrive.

Pearson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. We want a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We strive for a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities.

To learn more about Pearson’s commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce, navigate to: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Pearson.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing ppsmhr@pearson.com.

Note that the information you provide will stay confidential and will be stored securely. It will not be seen by those involved in making decisions as part of the recruitment process.
